senses.gloss:
€1P. (आञ्छति, आनञ्छ, आञ्छित) 
__1 To lengthen, stretch, extend. 
__2 To make straight. 
__3 To regulate, bring or draw into the right position; set (as a bone or leg); चकयोगेनाञ्छेदूर्वस्थि निर्गतम् [[Suśr.]]
Setting (a bone or leg); bringing into the right position by stretching, bending, or drawing.
